scenes.headline:
How does your inbox
spot *spam*?
scenes.voiceover: How does your inbox know this email is *spam*?

scenes.headline:
Too many tricks for
*hand-written rules*
scenes.voiceover: Rules can't catch every trick, so a network *learns* from examples.

scenes.headline:
Neurons add *weighted*
clues, pass the signal on
scenes.voiceover: Clues become numbers. Each neuron adds them up, *weighted* by importance.

scenes.headline:
Compare, then
*nudge* the weights
scenes.voiceover: Training compares its guess with the right answer, then *nudges* weights.

scenes.headline:
Many examples later, it
flags spam it *never saw*
scenes.voiceover: After many examples, it can flag spam it has *never seen*.
